name: Star Pearl Reliquary
introDiscord: A reliquary of star pearls preserves Moonkeeper vows beneath celestial coral.
introTwitch: A reliquary of star pearls preserves Moonkeeper vows beneath celestial coral.

luster-gate.name: Luster Gate
luster-gate.prompt: Soft luster washes across a gate where three aisles enter the submerged shrine.

left.message: The water folds around Star Pearl Guardian, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

right.message: Beneath an improvised shelter in Luster Gate, Shizuki left clean bandages and a medicinal flask. Her note reads: "Pearlward syrup. Saved for injuries and inconvenient revelations."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicinal flask at Luster Gate untouched for the next injured wanderer.

forward.message: Within Star Pearl Reliquary, the forward path from Luster Gate reveals a hidden moon-shell coffer.

reliquary-nave.name: Reliquary Nave
reliquary-nave.prompt: Pearl mosaics cover a long nave whose three branches bear faded symbols.

left.message: Within Star Pearl Reliquary, the left path from Reliquary Nave reveals a hidden Fae offering vessel.

right.message: The water folds around Star Pearl Guardian, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

forward.message: Inside a sealed journal cover at Reliquary Nave, Shizuki saved one Berry beside a note thanking the humans who called her a person.

pearlshadow-aisle.name: Pearlshadow Aisle
pearlshadow-aisle.prompt: Reflected starlight follows a quiet aisle to three sealed-looking passages.

left.message: Moonlight reveals an old sleeping spot at Pearlshadow Aisle. Beside it, Shizuki's restorative bottle says: "Keep one dose hidden where creators never think to look: somewhere joyful."
left.fullHpMessage: The restorative at Pearlshadow Aisle remains beside Shizuki's old sleeping spot; today you are already well.

right.message: Within Star Pearl Reliquary, the right path from Pearlshadow Aisle reveals a hidden Moonkeeper cache.

forward.message: The water folds around Star Pearl Guardian, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

boss-antechamber.name: Luminary Vault
boss-antechamber.prompt: A powerful presence shifts beyond the final threshold while the surrounding reef falls still.

bossPromptDiscord:
You reach Luminary Vault. The water tightens around an unseen guardian whose presence fills the chamber.
Use /yes to continue or /no to retreat for now.
bossPromptTwitch: Luminary Vault: An unseen guardian stirs beyond the threshold. Use !yes to continue or !no to retreat.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Luminary Vault. The hidden guardian remains beyond the threshold.

boss.revealText: The chamber answers with a surge of reef magic. Pearlward Luminary reveals itself!

completionText: Pearlward Luminary yields to the returning current. Star Pearl Reliquary settles into a quieter rhythm, and another route through the Moonlit Reef becomes clear.
